sql:
with o as (
  select lo.id, lo.kalshi_order_id, lo.strategy, lo.market_ticker, lo.created_at, lo.limit_price
  from live_orders lo
  where lo.side = 'no' and lo.action = 'buy' and lo.kalshi_order_id is not null and lo.limit_price is not null
    and lo.strategy in ('mmsell3','mmsell10','mmsell10a','mmsell10b','Lmmsell10','Cmmsell10','Dmmsell10','Emmsell10','Fmmsell10')
    and lo.created_at < '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z'
), f as (
  select kalshi_order_id, min(coalesce((raw_fill_json->>'created_time')::timestamptz, filled_at)) ft
  from fills where kalshi_order_id in (select kalshi_order_id from o) group by 1
), s as (
  select market_ticker, max(case when side = 'no' then resolved_value else 100 - resolved_value end) settle_no
  from paper_trades where resolved_value is not null and strategy like '%mmsell%'
    and market_ticker in (select market_ticker from o) group by 1
)
select o.strategy, o.market_ticker, o.created_at, f.ft, o.limit_price, s.settle_no
from o join f using (kalshi_order_id) left join s using (market_ticker) order by o.created_at
